entries.title: Loom library is not visible to the exporter
entries.root_cause: The loom library target is private to its package, but the exporter target depends on it. Its visibility must allow the exporter package.

entries.title: Gauge schema is not visible to the sampler
entries.root_cause: The gauge schema target is private to its package, but the sampler target depends on it. Its visibility must allow the sampler package.
entries.differs_from_earlier: The same Bazel visibility diagnostic concerns a different dependency and consumer; the gauge schema visibility needs its own change.

entries.title: Remote cache hostname cannot resolve
entries.root_cause: The configured remote cache hostname cache.tarn-sifter.invalid does not resolve on the runner. The remote cache endpoint configuration must be corrected.

entries.title: Remote cache hostname cannot resolve again
entries.root_cause: The configured remote cache hostname cache.tarn-sifter.invalid does not resolve on the runner. The remote cache endpoint configuration must be corrected.
entries.differs_from_earlier: A later build requests a different target on a newer runner, but the same configured hostname fails DNS resolution.
